# Sakura Player v1.2.0-beta.3

**Sakura Player 公开测试版 v1.2.0-beta.3 / Sakura Player Public Beta v1.2.0-beta.3**

## 简体中文

Sakura Player 是由 Sakura520222 维护的 [SPlayer-Next](https://github.com/SPlayer-Dev/SPlayer-Next) 非官方 Fork。v1.2.0-beta.3 是 Sakura Player 的第三个公开测试版本，在此前 v1.2.0-beta.2 的基础上带来了全新的本地歌词算法对齐系统、AI 歌词翻译与生成套件、歌词差异对比预览、音频平滑淡变与资源异步回收，并同步合入了上游流媒体架构重构、插件能力升级与多处关键修复。

### 新增与改进

- **本地歌词算法重对齐（基于 Python / Whisper / 启发式锚点）**：
  - 新增完整的本地歌词对齐功能与后台环境管理，提供基于轻量语音模型与文本对齐算法的本地逐字/短语级重对齐能力。
  - 支持本地歌词翻译短语对齐与音译锚点定位，完善跨词音译范围的保存与恢复逻辑。
  - 修复音译对齐后高亮刷新与默认歌词逐字渲染，新增对应开发与使用文档（[歌词算法对齐指引](docs/lyric-alignment.md)）。
- **AI 歌词套件与统一模型层**：
  - 新增 AI 歌词翻译功能，支持断点续译、目标语言选择与实时进度查看。
  - AI 歌词生成支持自选翻译、音译及逐字项目，并提供“补齐缺失”与“重新生成”两种模式，智能保留已有优质内容。
  - 建立统一的 AI 模型调用层，完善流式取消、安全校验、Thinking 配置及多种格式兼容，并细化错误反馈。
  - 新增歌词变更差异对比预览（Diff 对比），在保存或写入文件标签前可直观核对修改细节。
- **歌词渲染与排版增强**：
  - 支持辅助歌词折行字素级高亮与逐字译文顺排高亮，优化辅助歌词渲染性能。
  - 优化音译居中对齐与跨行显示效果。
- **音频核心体验优化**：
  - 增加音频播放启停平滑淡入淡出（Audio Fade），消除切歌与暂停瞬态爆音。
  - 改进切歌时的音频输出流异步回收与销毁机制，彻底解决切歌可能引发的音频输出流残留问题。
- **实用功能与界面优化**：
  - 我喜欢的音乐列表支持将选中歌曲信息批量复制到剪贴板。

### 同步上游改进与修复

- **流媒体子系统重构**：
  - 合入上游关于流媒体同步、收藏与播放会话的架构重构，支持流媒体旧协议兼容与单曲重播修复。
  - 修复 AMLL TTML 多值元数据键的索引解析问题。
- **插件系统与 MCP 扩展**：
  - 统一插件能力模型，扩展插件接口、权限隔离与独立音源支持，完善插件搜索入口。
  - 插件接口凭据安全隔离，保留完整曲目数据。
  - 完善播放队列查询接口，为插件和 MCP 协议提供统一的队列读取支持。
- **界面与设置修复**：
  - 修复设置搜索文案与子项高亮定位问题。
  - 修复列表表头布局并完善歌词字号配置。

### 下载与更新

| 平台    | 架构        | 包格式                                            |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows | x64 / ARM64 | 安装版 `.exe`、便携版 `.exe`                      |
| macOS   | x64 / ARM64 | `.dmg`、`.zip`                                    |
| Linux   | x64 / ARM64 | `.AppImage`、`.deb`、`.rpm`、`.tar.gz`、`.pacman` |

按设备架构选择发行页中的文件。Beta 版本不向 Stable 通道提供更新；已订阅 Beta 通道（或首发默认订阅）的用户可在新版本发布后接收更新。Nightly 使用独立的滚动发行和更新清单。草稿不提供公开下载或自动更新。

### 已知限制

- 这是测试版本，仍可能存在潜在问题。Windows 本地构建与基础冒烟已完成；macOS/Linux 和 ARM64 尚需真实设备上的安装、播放与更新验证，CI 构建成功不能替代这些验证。升级或迁移前请备份配置与音乐库。
- 本地歌词对齐功能需要本地 Python 运行环境或额外资源包支持，初次使用请参考相关指引。
- Windows 包目前未做代码签名；macOS 包未做签名和公证，系统可能显示信任提示。请仅使用本仓库发行页的资源。
- macOS、Windows 便携版及 Linux 解压版提供更新检查和外部下载；应用内下载安装仅对支持的安装形式开放。任务栏歌词和 WASAPI 独占输出仅适用于 Windows。
- Discord RPC 默认关闭，暂时保留上游 Application ID、资源和身份。
- 在线音乐、歌词及第三方 AI 模型的可用性取决于各自的接口、账号与服务规则。

## English

Sakura Player is an **unofficial fork** of [SPlayer-Next](https://github.com/SPlayer-Dev/SPlayer-Next), maintained by Sakura520222. Version v1.2.0-beta.3 is the third public Beta release of Sakura Player, bringing algorithmic local lyric alignment, a full-featured AI lyric translation and generation suite, pre-save lyric diff comparison, smooth audio fading with asynchronous output stream teardown, alongside upstream streaming refactoring, plugin capability upgrades, and essential bug fixes.

### Features & Improvements

- **Local Algorithmic Lyric Alignment**:
  - Introduced local lyric alignment with background runtime management, powered by lightweight speech recognition and text alignment algorithms for word/phrase-level precision.
  - Added support for local translation phrase alignment and romanization phonetic anchor tracking, with cross-word romanization range persistence.
  - Enhanced romanization alignment rendering and highlight refresh; added comprehensive documentation ([Lyric Alignment Guide](docs/lyric-alignment.md)).
- **AI Lyric Suite & Unified Model Layer**:
  - Added AI lyric translation with resume support, customizable target languages, and live progress tracking.
  - Added AI lyric generation with selective translation/romanization/word-by-word tasks and "fill missing" vs. "regenerate all" modes to preserve existing quality lyrics.
  - Built a unified AI model orchestration layer featuring streaming cancellation, request validation, thinking configuration, and rich error reporting.
  - Added visual lyric diff comparison preview before committing changes or saving to audio tags.
- **Enhanced Lyric Typography & Rendering**:
  - Supported grapheme-level wrapped auxiliary lyric highlighting and sequential word-by-word translation highlight with optimized rendering performance.
  - Refined romanization center-alignment and multi-line visual balance.
- **Audio Playback Improvements**:
  - Implemented smooth audio fading on start/pause/stop to eliminate popping artifacts.
  - Improved asynchronous audio output stream recycling on track switches, preventing dangling audio handles.
- **Productivity & UI Tweaks**:
  - Supported copying selected track metadata from the "Liked Songs" view directly to the clipboard.

### Upstream Fixes & Sync

- **Streaming Subsystem Refactoring**:
  - Synced upstream streaming refactor covering synchronization, favorites, and playback sessions, with backward compatibility and single-track replay fixes.
  - Fixed AMLL TTML multi-value metadata key indexing.
- **Plugin System & MCP Extensions**:
  - Unified plugin capability architecture, expanded interfaces and permission isolation, and added independent audio source plugins.
  - Isolated plugin credentials while preserving track details.
  - Added playback queue query interfaces for plugins and MCP clients.
- **UI & Settings Fixes**:
  - Fixed settings search terminology and sub-item anchor scrolling.
  - Polished table header layout in song and download lists.

### Packages and updates

Windows provides installer and portable `.exe` packages; macOS provides `.dmg` and `.zip`; Linux provides `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.tar.gz` and `.pacman`. Every platform targets both x64 and ARM64. Choose the architecture matching your device.

Beta releases do not update Stable subscribers. Future stable releases can reach Beta/Alpha subscribers. Nightly has a separate rolling release and update feed. Drafts are not publicly downloadable or discoverable by automatic updates.

### Known limitations

- This is a test release. Local Windows builds and basic smoke testing are complete; macOS/Linux and ARM64 still require installation, playback and update checks on real devices. Passing CI builds does not replace those checks. Back up settings and the library before upgrading or migrating.
- Local lyric alignment requires a local Python environment or supporting resource assets.
- Windows packages are unsigned, and macOS packages are unsigned and not notarized. The OS may display trust prompts. Download only from this repository's release page.
- macOS, Windows portable and Linux archive builds offer update checks and external downloads. In-app download/install is available only for supported installation types. Taskbar lyrics and WASAPI exclusive output are Windows-only.
- Discord RPC is disabled by default and temporarily retains the upstream Application ID, assets and identity.
- Online music, lyrics and third-party AI model integrations depend on their services, accounts and rules.
